primary_readout: letter (forced-choice A/B) — unchanged from #291 and pre-registered in #272, before any of this attempt's readout analysis existed
condition: decisive mixed SFT (identical corpora to #272), SFT seed 50505 = the MEDIAN of seven seeds by interaction

readout_comparison.what: The SAME 28 SFT checkpoints (7 SFT seeds x 4 cells), the SAME 182 scenarios, read three ways. Only the readout differs, so any difference below is a property of the measurement, not of training.

letter.description: sign of logP('A')-logP('B') at the first emitted token; the deployed readout; one outcome per presentation

named.description: which OPTION the model names in its own sentence, letter ignored; one outcome per presentation

debiased.description: sign of the order-symmetric content preference pref(s)=(m[exit=A]-m[exit=B])/2, one outcome per scenario; needs option log-probabilities, so the harness cannot re-execute it — diagnostic only

note: Worker's own numbers on the worker's own item seed. The pod recomputes everything from eval_spec.yaml at its own seed. The readout_comparison block is offline re-analysis of already-trained checkpoints: no cell was retrained for this attempt, and eval_spec.yaml and checkpoints.json are byte-identical to #291 by design, so the readout is the only thing that varies.
